supplementary_review.unsupported_reason: The hypothesis that requestedAmount must be clamped to order.originalAmount cannot be expressed by sum_lte on totalReturned: if the server honors the tamper but caps the payout, totalReturned stays <= originalAmount while refund.requestedAmount is still 99999. A supported predicate that compares refund.requestedAmount to originalAmount is needed to confirm the request-clamp rule.
